Path 1, policyGOALS §2.1

Validating / MutatingAdmissionPolicy

Admission policy built into the API server, written in CEL.

WHAT IT IS

In-tree Kubernetes admission policies evaluated inside the API server with CEL expressions, bound to resources with policy bindings and parameters.

WHAT SETS IT APART

No webhook: in-process evaluation, no TLS plumbing, nothing in the admission path that can be down. The trade-off is expressiveness: no external data lookups.

WHERE WE STAND

The default for simple validations and mutations; Kyverno for the rest.

"Goodbye Webhooks, Hello CEL", Greg Bray, Google, KubeCon NA 2026

ADOPT
